items.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Danny Thomas was his name! ... he didn’t know me, but he knew it was being recorded

ctx.x: He had a daughter or somebody, also who was famous. Anyways, never mind. He made millions.

Danny Thomas was his name! Thank you Maureen! Perfect. Yeah he was there and he knew I was recording, and he didn’t know me, but he knew it was being recorded, and he didn’t want me to record that. So we had to add a little bit of confusion to all these guys on the stage and Lawrence Welk was perfect, he was so precise. Each musician, each section, he’d blend the…there was no mixing, he’d blend it so it was perfectly blended. It just sounded so beautiful. I wonder what happened to that record. That was one of the…
